landingPage.resumeText: Polytechnic Engineer in Cybersecurity & Digital Forensics. CISO (RSSI) at BVMAC · Security Engineer at adorsys. Certified ISO/IEC 27001, CCNP, NSE4, CCT, CPTA v2. Ethical Hacker · CTF Player · OSINT Researcher.

forensique.title: Forensics
forensique.contentText: Solid knowledge of digital forensics principles: data acquisition, analysis and evidence presentation. Experience in incident response, OSINT research and security investigation.

devsecops.title: DevSecOps
devsecops.contentText: Design and deployment of ISSP, SIEM/SOC solutions, BCP/DRP, and security frameworks (ISO 27001/27002/27005, NIST CSF, EBIOS RM). Proficient in Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, Tekton CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes.

pentesting.title: Pentesting
pentesting.contentText: Intrusion testing and vulnerability assessment. Reconnaissance, exploitation, post-exploitation and reporting. Identification and remediation of vulnerabilities to ensure the security of systems and networks.

developpement.title: Development
developpement.contentText: Expertise in Python, Java, JavaScript, C, Bash, Rust and others. Experience in web development, automation, security tool development and open-source contributions on GitHub.

aboutMePage.title: WHOAMI
aboutMePage.paragraph_one: Polytechnic Engineer in Cybersecurity and Digital Forensics, Ethical Hacker, certified ISO/IEC 27001 Associate, CCNP, CCT, CSCU, CPTA v2, and NSE4 Fortinet. Currently serving as CISO (RSSI) at BVMAC and Security Engineer at adorsys GmbH & Co. KG, with expertise in intrusion testing, incident response, OSINT research, and offensive & defensive security.
aboutMePage.paragraph_two: Experienced in designing and deploying Information System Security Policies (ISSP), SIEM/SOC solutions (Wazuh, Splunk, IBM QRadar, Snort 3), Business Continuity Plans (BCP/DRP), and security frameworks (ISO 27001/27002/27005, NIST CSF, EBIOS RM, RGPD). Proficient in Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, Tekton CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).
aboutMePage.paragraph_three: Laureate of the o'100 OKWELEANS Excellence Program (2023) and Hall of Fame at EC-COUNCIL Cyber Challenge (2022). Passionate CTF player and winner of the 2021 Cybersecurity Experts Olympiad. Committed to continuous learning and advancing cybersecurity.
